column1: # Status vectors. Shared by the engine test (control.rs, every pair GetStatus
# can report has a row and every row is such a pair) and the extension test
# (lib.test.js, statusText gives these texts), so the Rust codes and the menu
# app_mode is correct, learn_only, off or none; app_reason is a reason code,
# empty with none. NAME stands for the focused app's name. Texts are the spec's
# "Engine not running", "enabled = false" and "learning = false" are not
# pairs: the extension handles them before looking up a row.
# off/no_replace (an allowlisted terminal whose field cannot take a
# replacement) has no row of its own in the spec table: it reuses the
# no_replace app line and the off-in-this-field subtitle.
